req.title: Player payload includes position
req.statement: The system shall include the position field on every player response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-034 requires that every player response includes the 'position' field. Tests must verify: (1) a normal GET /players/{id} returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty 'position' field (positive/EP); (2) a GET with an invalid UUID returns HTTP 422 and no player body (negative/NEG); (3) a GET for a non-existent valid UUID returns HTTP 404 (negative/NEG); (4) the position field value exactly matches the seeded data for a known player (EP + mutation-resilience); (5) boundary: the first and last seeded players both carry 'position' (BVA); (6) a player whose position is a long string still returns it intact (BVA). All tests use FastAPI TestClient in-process, assert exact status codes and exact field values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_position_present_and_exact_for_known_player
preconditions: Player with id=97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802 exists with position='Defensive Midfield'
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_position_present_and_exact_for_known_player():
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'position' in body
    assert body['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'
    assert body['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'

tests.name: test_position_present_for_all_seeded_players_via_id
preconditions: All 26 players have non-null position values
actions: Send GET /players/{id} for each of the 26 seeded player UUIDs
Verify each response contains a non-empty position field
expected: Every response body contains 'position' key with a non-empty string
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

SEEDED = [
    ('97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802', 'Defensive Midfield'),
    ('3a34bd83-441a-4abe-9f6f-210579e1be4b', 'Centre-Forward'),
    ('595b47db-fe68-441b-9ce1-7d2f2bb362a5', 'Left-Back'),
    ('baee3972-0bb4-4450-bf9f-2284666a65e5', 'Centre-Back'),
    ('2b515093-76be-4c72-98de-729c368f7ddb', 'Central Midfield'),
    ('dd957ea5-fa5d-4250-9abf-e7b2420479bc', 'Defensive Midfield'),
    ('428488a6-202f-41d6-81d0-53b91fcac8c8', 'Centre-Back'),
    ('0654d83f-f48d-4ea9-847c-8a88ffc4aad6', 'Centre-Back'),
    ('b24f74ac-bb2d-4e87-97ea-679b802116dd', 'Attacking Midfield'),
    ('e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6', 'Right Winger'),
]

def test_position_present_for_all_seeded_players_via_id():
    for pid, expected_pos in SEEDED:
        r = client.get(f'/players/{pid}')
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200 for {pid}, got {r.status_code}'
        body = r.json()
        assert 'position' in body, f'position missing for {pid}'
        assert body['position'] == expected_pos, f'Wrong position for {pid}'
        assert isinstance(body['position'], str)
        assert len(body['position']) > 0

tests.name: test_position_field_type_and_non_null_for_multiple_positions
preconditions: Database seeded with players having varied positions: Goalkeeper, Centre-Forward, Right Winger, Attacking Midfield, Left-Back
actions: Send GET /players/{id} for players with distinct position values
Assert each returns HTTP 200 with correct exact position string
expected: position field present and matches expected value exactly for each player
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response regardless of position value
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

CASES = [
    ('a2fd538c-7747-40d5-a480-a1ecac098787', 'Goalkeeper'),
    ('3a34bd83-441a-4abe-9f6f-210579e1be4b', 'Centre-Forward'),
    ('e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6', 'Right Winger'),
    ('b24f74ac-bb2d-4e87-97ea-679b802116dd', 'Attacking Midfield'),
    ('595b47db-fe68-441b-9ce1-7d2f2bb362a5', 'Left-Back'),
]

def test_position_field_type_and_non_null_for_multiple_positions():
    for pid, expected_pos in CASES:
        r = client.get(f'/players/{pid}')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        body = r.json()
        assert 'position' in body
        assert isinstance(body['position'], str)
        assert body['position'] == expected_pos

tests.name: test_position_key_present_in_response_schema
preconditions: Database seeded; player id=e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6 has position='Right Winger'
actions: Inspect all top-level keys of the response JSON
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_position_key_present_in_response_schema():
    r = client.get('/players/e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    required_keys = {'id', 'firstName', 'lastName', 'squadNumber', 'position'}
    for key in required_keys:
        assert key in body, f'Missing key: {key}'
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['id'] == 'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6'
